scope: Proposition 8.6 (Finiteness of all ordinary lattices) of the manuscript “The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments” (preprints/The-height-three-chromatic-overlap-an-explicit-filtration-and-its-attachments-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 05577ee22db5cad1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 69. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every a ≥ 0, d ∈ Z, and coefficient line L specified above, the group Ha cts(P3, Ad(L)) is finite. This includes all periodicity, determinant, conormal, and canonical-line twists and their inverses, with the original (x, y)-adic lattice topology. The conclusion uses no finiteness or cohomology comparison for B0.
